Get the size and questionnaire means of clusters

Source: R/clustering_osivq.R
summarise_clustering.Rd

Get the size and questionnaire means of clusters

Usage

summarise_clustering(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame with columns group, cluster, vviq_total_score, osivq_object, osivq_spatial, osivq_verbal, and raven_score.

Value

A data frame summarizing the clusters, including the number of participants in each cluster and the mean scores for VVIQ, OSIVQ object, OSIVQ spatial, OSIVQ verbal, and Raven scores.

Examples

df <- get_clean_data()$df_survey
clustering <- cluster_osivq(df)

df |>
 add_named_clusters(clustering) |>
 summarise_clustering()
